map_rules.orientation: north up; never mirror geography for RTL
map_rules.scope: Country silhouettes include all supplied parts; Oman retains Musandam and separated parts. Borders generalized at 1:10m, not cadastral or navigational.
map_rules.routes: No actual sea/road route data supplied. Do not draw a curve through land as a sailing route. A separate linear process timeline may say schematic.
map_rules.node_precision: Rounded display markers; source precision is not an accuracy guarantee; do not snap sea-port point to simplified coastline.
map_rules.svg: 600x600 viewBox; map and labels in separate layers; svg_xy included; labels may move but points must not. Use country-rings if reprojecting.
